name: @nabu/pipeline
description: Turbo shim so `pnpm lint|typecheck|test|codegen` also run the Python pipeline (uv).

scripts.codegen: node ../packages/schema/scripts/emit-bundle.ts > .bundle.schema.json && uv run --frozen datamodel-codegen --input .bundle.schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output src/nabu/schema/models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.12 --use-annotated --use-type-alias --enum-field-as-literal all --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --use-title-as-name --use-schema-description --field-constraints --enable-faux-immutability --strict-nullable --disable-timestamp --custom-file-header-path scripts/models-header.txt --formatters ruff-format ruff-check; rm -f .bundle.schema.json
scripts.lint: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
